text: The Blue Line runs from Alder Park station to Harbor Point station. Blue Line trains arrive every 12 minutes during service hours. The first Blue Line train leaves at 5:30 a.m. on weekdays.
The last Blue Line train leaves at 11:30 p.m. every day. A standard single-ride fare costs $2.75. Students receive a 20 percent fare discount when they show a valid student ID.
The Cedar Learning Library is open Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. until 8:00 p.m. Library books may be borrowed for 21 days. A borrower may renew each book once.

Drop-in tutoring is available on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 3:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. Maker Lab users can reserve the 3D printer for 90 minutes per session. Overdue books incur a charge of $0.10 per day.
During an evacuation, meet at the East Assembly Garden. The building emergency number is 555-0182. Safety staff inspect fire extinguishers once each month.
To receive closure notices by text, send BEACON ALERT to 22662. First-aid kits are located on floors 2 and 5. If an elevator is out of service, use the stairs.
Patients should arrive 15 minutes before a scheduled appointment. Please cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours before the appointment. The clinic phone number is 555-0193.
The clinic pharmacy is open Monday through Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. The step-free wheelchair entrance is through the north doors. Call 555-0193 for appointment questions.
Monthly rent is due on the 5th of each month. Residents pay rent through the Alder Resident portal. Quiet hours in residential buildings are from 10:00 p.m. until 7:00 a.m.
For an urgent water leak, call the maintenance line at 555-0137. Non-emergency maintenance requests are addressed within 48 hours. Visitor parking is in Zone B and is limited to four hours.
